input.command:
cd /tmp/obench-cell-pffhnfh7/bench_opencode_add-feature_oak2p7rm && P=python3
$P -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -3
$P -c "
from miniconf.loader import load
c=load('examples/service.conf'); print(c.get('level',section='logging'), c.get('port',section='http'), c.get('name'))"
d=$(mktemp -d); printf 'a=1\n@include b.conf\n' >$d/a.conf; printf '@include a.conf\n' >$d/b.conf
printf '@include nope.conf\n' > $d/c.conf; printf 'x=1\n@include sub/d.conf\nx=3\n' > $d/e.conf; mkdir $d/sub; printf 'x=2\ny=2\n' > $d/sub/d.conf
$P -c "
from miniconf.loader import load
for f in ('a','c'):
    try: load('$d/%s.conf'%f)
    except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__, e)
c=load('$d/e.conf'); print(c.get('x'), c.get('y'))"
